[[Tlehco]] is an [[ascended weapon]] and the [[Precursor weapon|precursor]] to the [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] scepter [[Xiuquatl]] crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]], through various materials and tasks. Requires completion of [[Anima]] for recipe unlock.
